rationale: The short thesis required CZR to stay below session VWAP ($29.10) and the 5m 9-EMA ($29.10); instead price has reverted from 29.06 to 29.09 and is pinning right at VWAP, with the last five 1m candles stepping higher rather than breaking the 29.01 low. No compelling long case exists at VWAP on a flat tape to justify a flip.
